mkdir -p programs; cat > programs/task-74d3d939.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Fill a single background cell between consecutive foreground cells in each row.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg]
    fg = Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w-1):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and grid[r][c-1] == fg and grid[r][c+1] == fg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY

    fg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
